title: Sightline truncation at driveways, ROWs and street corners
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within 1.5m of where walls, fences, or other structures adjoin: i. a driveway that intersects a street, right-of-way or communal street; ii. a right-of-way or communal street that intersects a public street; and iii. two streets that intersect (refer Figure 3.7c). C3.7.6 C3.7.5 does not apply where an existing or planned pedestrian path, shared path or road alignment is located more than 1.5m from the street boundary.

exceptions.label: C3.7.6 path, shared path or road alignment more than 1.5 m from the street boundary

replaces.note: C3.7.6 path-offset exemption is new to Part B

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: One yes/no covering all three locations in (i)-(iii). C3.7.6 is recorded as an exception on this rule, not a separate file. site.verge.path_or_road_offset_m is the nearer of the existing or planned path/road alignment.
